description: This file contains React hook functions and related utilities for managing and retrieving task data, integrating with a Supabase backend. It includes task stats computations, CRUD operations for tasks, and real-time updates.

methods.name: useTaskStats()
methods.description: Custom React hook to fetch and subscribe to real-time task statistics for the current user, based on data from Supabase.

methods.name: createTask(client, userId, { title, description = "", due_date = null, status = "open" })
methods.description: Creates a new task record for a user in the database.

methods.name: updateTask(client, taskId, patch)
methods.description: Updates an existing task with partial data.

methods.name: getTask(client, taskId)
methods.description: Fetches a single task by its ID.

methods.name: listTasks(client, userId, { status, search } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks for a user, optionally filtered by status or search term.
